name: GuestDB
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt > /tmp/guestdb_setup.log 2>&1 && echo PIP_OK >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log && python manage.py migrate >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log 2>&1 && echo MIGRATE_OK >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log && python manage.py setup_roles >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log 2>&1 && python manage.py seed_users >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log 2>&1 && python manage.py createsuperuser --noinput >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log 2>&1; python manage.py seed_mock_contacts --total 1000 >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log 2>&1; echo SETUP_DONE >> /tmp/guestdb_setup.log; tail -20 /tmp/guestdb_setup.log'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'pkill -f runserver 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; nohup python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000 > /tmp/guestdb.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; echo "server start attempt at $(date)" >> /tmp/guestdb.log'
